name: Guyomard

attributes.attribute: a knight and lover of the magician
broke the charm and freed the knight

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Guyomard was a knight of Arthur and the lover of the king's half sister. That sister was the sorceress Morgan. The knight broke faith, and she, angry, flung a curse. The curse fell upon a valley in the magic wood of Broceliande. Any knight who entered that valley, being false to his love, could not leave. About him rose demons and rocks he could not break. The loyal Lancelot freed them all at last and broke the charm.

okr.objective: Tell how a foul knight and a sorceress made a cursed valley.
key_results: Name the knight Guyomard and his fault.
